Author: Rayla Petal
Name: WatchAlong
Description:
Puts a Kosmi room on a screen inside FFXIV, joining as a real Kosmi guest via a
sandboxed out-of-process browser, so playback stays perfectly synced with the rest of the room.

Commands:
/wa - toggle the main viewer/control window
/wa view - open the main window
/wa join <kosmi url or WA1: invite> - join a room, or accept an invite (with confirmation)
/wa settings - open Settings (identity, volume/mute, join/leave, invite, screen placement)
/wa invite - copy a shareable invite for your current room and screen
/wa sync <WA1P: message> - apply a shared screen position (with confirmation)
/wa place - open the screen placement window
/wa focus - snap the camera to a fullscreen view of your placed screen (move to exit)
/wa forgetvenues - forget every remembered watch-along room (stops auto-rejoining any of them)
/wa vol <0-150> - set volume
/wa mute - toggle mute
/wa snapshot - save a debug screenshot + DOM outline
Punchline: Watch a Kosmi room together, in-game.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- Freecam now glides smoothly instead of moving in small jumps.
- Freecam up/down now works with E (up) and Q (down), whatever those keys are bound to. While the camera is moving they won't fire your hotbar skills, and they type normally in chat. Your Jump and Descend keys still work too.
- Freecam up/down movement is slower, so it's easier to line up a shot.
TestingChangelog:
PoseKit 3.0 - testing build

Quick Library
- New on-screen library chip opens a compact animation picker. It's always shown while paired and can be hidden when solo (Settings).
- Browse by Futa, Gay, Straight or Lesbian, then by category (Vanilla, Romantic, BDSM, Rough...), or open Solo, Idles and Dancing.
- Laid out like the main window: mod, then animation, then its roles and variants. Counts are per animation.
- Shows only what you can play right now: ground sits, dozes and emotes while standing, sit poses while seated, doze poses while lying down. Opens by itself when you sit or lie down.
- Search stays inside the category you're in. Right-click an animation's title to change its categories or hide it.
- Rescan and Reload categories buttons in the library header.
- Adjust section with the gizmo and Bone Align (parts, gap, auto-align, quick turns, Align and Remember).
- Pair with your target straight from the library.

Categories
- Animations are sorted automatically from their names and descriptions; your own tags (categories.json) always win.
- Couple animations that don't need a penis show under both Straight and Lesbian.
- Hardcore-rated scenes and fisting go under Rough. Standalone Dom/Sub mods are recognised as couples.

Posing
- Doze anywhere: doze poses play where you stand and others see them. Beds and chairs still place you on them.
- Gizmo: drag handles on your character to move or turn your offset.
- Bone Align turns you to face your partner's direction first ("Face partner's direction", on by default).
- Nudging a remembered animation by hand saves the new placement to Bone Align's memory.

Pairing
- Right-click a player (world, chat, party, friends) and choose "Pair with PoseKit".
- Picking one role of a couple animation can send your partner the other role.

- New "What's new" window after updates; reopen it with /posekit changelog.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Oathbound
Description: A consent-based collar control plugin. Gameplay commands use ordinary in-game tells; relay-assisted pairing and encrypted catalog synchronization use the Oathbound Cloudflare service, while gameplay actions remain local to the Sub's client.
Punchline: Consent-based Owner/Sub control: outfit, title, gesture, and leash.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Cummy
Description:
Pair with someone over tells, then right-click them to layer cum onto a body part. Layers stack on top of their own current skin (Bibo body), are published through Penumbra so sync plugins show them to everyone, and stay until cleaned or dried off.
Requires Penumbra. 18+ content.
Punchline: Cum layering system for your paired partners.
Changelog:
- Full Body is no longer its own part: it layers every body part you haven't blocked one stage, so the first Full Body is a light coat all over, the second takes everything to stage 2, and the third to stage 3. One notification and one moodle per Full Body.
- Full Body no longer has its own row, art or block. A Full Body you had on becomes stage 1 on your clean body parts.
